cards.title: PR-only path filter
items: Only pull requests targeting master with changes under the listed product, test, public, E2E, root HTML/package/configuration, or standalone-doc paths trigger this workflow.
GitHub Actions workflow/action changes and release-script changes are outside the allowlist; standalone operator documentation is included. This workflow has no push trigger.

cards.title: Independent jobs · configured checks
items: Repository policy and application validation are independent jobs. Application validation runs npm ci, lint, typecheck, unit tests, Pages-base build, then Chromium, Firefox and WebKit browser smoke checks.

This diagram describes configured CI, not a successful run. Release candidate validation requires the candidate SHA to exactly match the protected master tip and both named CI contexts to pass on that exact SHA.
Path-filtered workflow skips can leave a required check pending or skipped; confirm branch protection does not treat a skipped required workflow as satisfied before relying on a green merge gate.
